instruction: Glitch is crashing. Have him jab the stimpak into his own arm.

target.reason: The stimpak already sits in glitch's hands, but none of the page's verbs can make him use it on himself: offer only passes it to another person, and accept/refuse belong to a recipient, so there is no action that turns the stimpak into a jab in his own arm.
